newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Lamfalussy says dollar at a reasonable level.
newsitem.headline: Lamfalussy says dollar at a reasonable level.

text.p: Alexandre Lamfalussy, president of the European Monetary Institute, said on Tuesday he believed the dollar was at a reasonable level and had corrected its recent misalignment.

"(The dollar exchange rate) is not bad. I think it is at a reasonable level. It has corrected the recent misalignment," Lamfalussy told reporters as he arrived at a conference organised by the Austrian National Bank.
